theorems.name: Submission.doragm_radial_first_variation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (H : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ W → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure) → ∀ (y : Euclid P) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (A τ : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → (∀ u, u ≤ 1 → φ u = 1) → (∀ u, A ≤ u → φ u = 0) → 0 < τ → closedBall y (A * τ) ⊆ W → (n : ℝ) * (∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) ∂R.measure) + (∫ x, ‖x - y‖ / τ * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) * (1 - ‖(x - y) - (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - y)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure) = -∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) * inner ℝ (x - y) (H x) ∂R.measure
